inclusionPolicy: All six user-confirmed official LoL wagers are included. Wagers 3, 4 and 6 are user-directed probation exceptions with execution or recommendation-status deviations preserved. Wager 5 was fully model-compliant.

strictModelApprovedExecutionView.note: The Dignitas +9.5 wager is excluded because the recommendation was LEAN — 0u watch and the official positive-underdog handicap gate was not passed. The accepted price itself remained within the numerical move thresholds.

wagers.event: Anyone's Legend vs ThunderTalk Gaming — Game 1
wagers.primaryError: Early neutrality and nominal waveclear were incorrectly treated as demonstrated stall evidence; stronger-team and structure-acceleration risk was underpriced.

wagers.event: Anyone's Legend vs ThunderTalk Gaming — Game 2
wagers.primaryCaution: The wager won narrowly at 28 kills; the result supports the clean-close branch but does not validate the original probability range by itself.

wagers.event: Top Esports vs LGD Gaming — Game 3
wagers.primaryError: Temporary recovery and low tower progression were treated as durable resistance without proving that LGD could survive the next major objective-loss branch.
wagers.executionDeviation: Immediate same-state odds move from 1.827 to 2.117 exceeded both material reassessment thresholds.

wagers.primaryError: An official duration over was issued without completing the existing required duration block or establishing a conservative earliest finish safely beyond the line.
wagers.executionDeviation: Odds moved by 0.101 and stake exceeded the 0.25u map cap by 0.05u.

wagers.event: Karmine Corp vs Natus Vincere — Game 1
wagers.entryState: At 10:46 NAVI led 2-0 in kills, approximately 0.6k gold and 3-0 in Void Grubs, with towers and dragons 0-0.
wagers.primaryError: The model treated a modest early kill/economy lead plus Void Grubs as sufficient moneyline confirmation without adequately pricing KC's player-strength and lead-conversion advantage.
wagers.userAssessment: NAVI threw the game; player difference decided the result.

wagers.entryState: At 14:12 Cloud9 Kia led 5-4 in kills and approximately 1.1k gold; towers were 0-0, Cloud9 held the first dragon and Dignitas held three Void Grubs.
wagers.executionDeviation: Accepted odds moved from 1.716 to 1.744 (+0.028), within the numerical move thresholds. The recommendation was still not an official bet and the two-conversion handicap gate was not passed.
wagers.primaryCaution: The winning result validates the handicap direction for this map but does not retroactively convert the lean into a model-approved official recommendation.

remainingProbationPlan.selectionPolicy: Selectivity over action. Every official recommendation must pass the current market-specific gate at the synchronized state and accepted price.
remainingProbationPlan.performanceSeparation: User-confirmed placements from a lean count in the user-defined probation but remain excluded from strict model-approved performance.

reviewConclusion.primaryModelIssue: Duration-over promotion from correlated quiet-state evidence remains the largest official-wager issue. The broader lean sample also showed weak moneyline leans from soft evidence and repeated positive-handicap re-entry after functional collapse.
reviewConclusion.primaryProcedureIssue: Live recommendations must verify functional return damage, apply same-map thesis lockouts, distinguish observed kill velocity from draft-only volatility, and track revised lines beneath one market-family thesis.
reviewConclusion.primaryExecutionIssue: Wagers 3 and 4 crossed material execution boundaries. Wager 6 stayed within numerical price tolerance but remained outside strict model-approved attribution because it was placed from a lean without the official handicap gate.
actions: Activated lol-v0.3.13 with complete synchronized-state requirements, durable anti-conversion evidence, fastest-finish-path inventory, finish-window margin, and one-fight compression controls.
Activated lol-v0.3.14 with item inventory, usable-strength classification, damage-versus-durability comparison, unknown-item veto, and item-completion expiry triggers.
Activated lol-v0.3.15: item snapshots are optional before 15:00 and mandatory at or after 15:00 when decision-critical.
Activated lol-v0.3.16: draft evaluation scores damage delivery, carry protection, execution burden, and single-point-of-failure risk.
Activated lol-v0.3.17: underdog live moneylines require hard conversion evidence, next-two-sequence analysis, favorite comeback pricing, and lead-conversion reliability checks.

Activated lol-v0.3.18: moneyline leans require current-map confirmation; positive-underdog handicaps require functional return damage and a next-fight stress test; withdrawn same-map theses are locked out until repaired; kill Overs require observed pace; revised lines are tracked beneath one thesis.
Duration Overs are not eligible for official recommendation during probation wagers 7-10.
Continue separating user-directed lean executions from strict model-approved official performance.
